Post-Procedure Care

Proper care ensures the best results after your brow transplant. Follow these key steps:

  • Avoid Touching: The implanted area should not be disturbed for the first few days.
  • Follow-Up Visits:  Regular check-ins with your surgeon help monitor progress and address any concerns.
  • Expect Shedding: It's normal for transplanted hairs to shed initially. Permanent growth will begin within a few months.

The experts at Ryan Clinic provide detailed post-procedure instructions and are always available to address concerns.

faq.question: Am I a suitable candidate for an eyebrow transplant?
faq.answer: Suitability depends on the cause and extent of your brow thinning, donor hair availability and your overall health. A clinical consultation at Ryan Clinic in Delhi is required to assess your individual situation and determine the most appropriate treatment path.

faq.question: What happens during the initial consultation?
faq.answer: The clinical team evaluates your existing brow tissue, natural brow pattern, donor hair characteristics and medical history. They explain the procedure, expected timeline and what realistic results look like for your specific case. You can ask questions and receive a treatment plan before making any commitment.

faq.question: How is the procedure performed?
faq.answer: Individual hair follicles are extracted from a donor area — usually the scalp — and implanted into the brow region following the natural direction of brow hair growth. The procedure is performed under local anaesthesia. Duration depends on the number of follicles required. Your surgeon will advise you on what to expect on the day.

faq.question: What should I expect during recovery?
faq.answer: Some redness, minor swelling and scabbing in the brow area are normal in the initial days. Implanted hairs may shed within the first few weeks before regrowing gradually. Recovery experience varies by individual. The clinical team provides specific aftercare instructions and scheduled follow-up support.

faq.question: When will I see results, and are they long-lasting?
faq.answer: Early regrowth typically begins within a few months, with more visible results developing over six to twelve months. Transplanted follicles are long-lasting; however, because they retain scalp hair growth characteristics, they will continue growing and require regular trimming. Individual outcomes vary based on biological factors and adherence to aftercare guidance.

metadata.overviewData:
Eyebrow Transplant in Delhi — Restore Natural Brow Density

Sparse, uneven or absent eyebrows can result from over-plucking, alopecia, scarring, hormonal changes, ageing or genetics. At Ryan Clinic in Delhi, eyebrow transplant treatment is planned individually for each patient based on their natural brow shape, facial structure and donor hair characteristics.

Our clinical team offers a personalised consultation to assess whether an eyebrow transplant is suitable for you, explain the procedure in detail and set realistic expectations about results.

What Is an Eyebrow Transplant?

An eyebrow transplant involves transferring individual hair follicles from a donor area — typically the scalp — to the eyebrow region using precise implantation techniques. Because the transplanted follicles retain the growth characteristics of scalp hair, they continue to grow and require periodic trimming. The transplanted hair integrates gradually over several months, and final results vary by individual based on donor hair quality, skin type and healing response.

Why Consider an Eyebrow Transplant?

Patients may benefit from an eyebrow transplant consultation if they experience:

  • Persistent sparse or absent brow areas that do not respond to topical treatments
  • Scarring within the brow region following injury or surgery
  • Brow thinning related to medical treatment or health conditions
  • Desire for a more defined and natural brow appearance

Who Is a Suitable Candidate?

Suitability is assessed during your in-person consultation at Ryan Clinic, Delhi. Factors considered include donor hair availability, the nature and extent of brow loss, skin condition and your general health. Not every patient is a surgical candidate; the clinical team will explain all appropriate options.

typesData.details:
Eyebrow Transplant Procedure: Step-by-Step Guide

Achieve fuller, natural-looking eyebrows with a permanent eyebrow transplant at Ryan Clinic. Our expert surgeons follow a precise and minimally invasive process to ensure seamless results.

1. Consultation:

Your eyebrow transplant journey begins with a personalized consultation, where our specialists assess your brow area and discuss your desired shape, thickness, and symmetry.

2. Hair Follicle Extraction:

Using advanced, minimally invasive techniques, healthy hair follicles are carefully harvested from the donor area, typically the back of the scalp.

3. Precision Implantation:

The extracted follicles are strategically implanted into the eyebrow area, ensuring they follow the natural growth direction for a flawless and long-lasting look.

This meticulous procedure guarantees seamless blending with your existing hair, restoring beautifully shaped, well-defined eyebrows.
